reviews.author: Nadia Fenwick
reviews.headline: The indigo is deeper in person
reviews.body: Photographs read almost navy; in daylight it is a proper inky indigo with the floral picked out in a lighter thread. Wore it to a summer wedding and was asked about it four times.

reviews.author: Beatrix Ohl
reviews.headline: Size up if you are between
reviews.body: The silk hangs beautifully and the seams are clean inside and out. Cut is narrow across the shoulders, so I swapped the M for an L and it is now perfect.
